name: opencode-target
description: Persistent verified Target runtime for OpenCode with automatic continuation, budgets, circuit breakers, and an animated TUI status indicator.

scripts.build:local: node scripts/build-local.mjs && node scripts/build-tui.mjs && node scripts/build-install.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/core.test.js test/adapter.test.js test/store.test.js test/ledger.test.js test/scheduler.test.js test/traversal.test.js test/repository.test.js test/verification.test.js test/continuation.test.js test/options.test.js test/host.test.js test/errors.test.js test/event-routing.test.js test/error-lifecycle.test.js test/tool-accounting.test.js test/verification-gate.test.js test/context-hooks.test.js test/commands.test.js test/tui-state.test.js test/install-config.test.js
scripts.test:smoke: node test/server-smoke.mjs && node test/continuation-smoke.mjs && node test/budget-wrapup-smoke.mjs && node test/restart-smoke.mjs && npm run test:tui && node test/install-script-smoke.mjs
scripts.check:tui: tsc -p tsconfig.tui.json && node --check src/tui-state.js && node --check install-config.mjs && node --check dist/target-tui.js && node --check dist/install-config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:tui && npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.check: npm run build:local && node --check src/core.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/options.js && node --check src/host.js && node --check src/errors.js && node --check src/event-routing.js && node --check src/error-lifecycle.js && node --check src/tool-accounting.js && node --check src/verification-gate.js && node --check src/context-hooks.js && node --check src/commands.js && node --check src/store.js && node --check src/repository.js && node --check src/verification.js && node --check src/continuation.js && node --check src/ledger.js && node --check src/adapter.js && node --check src/scheduler.js && node --check src/traversal.js && node --check dist/target.js && node scripts/check-dist.mjs && npm run test
